headline: Executive order creates a White House council to look at government rules that may make housing less affordable.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new White House council focused on housing costs. Based on its title, the council's job is to find and address government rules and regulations seen as barriers to building or providing affordable housing. No official summary was provided, so specific details about the council's members, powers, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that deal with housing
who_it_affects.how: Agency officials may take part in the council or be asked to review their housing-related rules.
Any changes to rules that come from the council's work could affect housing costs and supply, though the order itself does not set specific changes.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 25, 2019; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
